description: Hypothesis: fuse target RMSNorm, optional residual addition and existing FP16 projection-input packing to reduce prefill memory traffic and dispatches. The 128-wide gated norm omits four all-zero SIMD groups while preserving active reduction and expression order. Reuse existing scratch; no precision, weight, KV, recurrence, attention, expert matrix, draft FC, context capture, prefix checkpoint, chunk-size or context-limit change. A vectorized expert-combine prototype was measured and rejected. Preserve affine-8 group-64 v2 target cache, BF16 draft checkpoint, FP16 KV, FP32 state/accumulation, staged8, 2048-token chunks and 32768-token context. Run all seven Full-profile tests. The latest main evaluation pin advances only repository records; definition and evaluator scripts match the base.
